title: Waymo in Toronto
author: ChrisArchitect
relevanceReason: 命中 3 个 AI/科技关键词。
summaryRaw: Waymo is officially heading to Canada! We’re laying the groundwork for our fully autonomous ride-hailing service in Toronto, investing in local facilities and jobs, with the goal of welcoming our first riders in 2028.In the coming days, you’ll start to see Waymo vehicles on the streets of Toronto as we begin driving manually. We are taking a rigorous, phased, safety-first approach starting with high-definition mapping of local street networks and testing with trained autonomous specialists behind the wheel. This validation period will ensure the Waymo Driver adapts seamlessly to Toronto’s distinct driving conditions.“Expanding into Canada marks an important milestone in Waymo’s global journey,” said Waymo co-CEO Tekedra Mawakana. “Toronto is one of the world’s great cities — innovative, diverse, and forward-looking. We’re proud to bring the Waymo Driver to Canada’s largest city and to partner with the vibrant business, arts and cultural communities that share our commitment to safer streets and more accessible mobility.”To serve Toronto, we’re partnering with Element Fleet Management, a Toronto-headquartered company and global leader in intelligent fleet and mobility solutions that will provide end-to-end fleet management services. Together with Element and our partners, we’ll invest in hundreds of roles over time spanning fleet maintenance, validation driving, customer service, and other operations functions that support our service. This deep partnership builds on Waymo’s existing ties to Canada, which includes our long-term investor relationship with the Canada Pension Plan Investment Board and our manufacturing partner, Magna International."As a Canadian company, we are proud to be expanding our partnership with Waymo to help bring autonomous ride-hailing to Toronto,” said Laura Dottori-Attanasio, Chief Executive Officer, Element Fleet Management. Together with Waymo, Element will help create employment opportunities providing the fleet expertise, operational capabilities, and intelligent mobility solutions needed to support autonomous fleets reliably and at scale."As one of North America’s fastest-growing metropolitan regions, Toronto has both evolving mobility demands and a dynamic and growing number of tools. From bike lanes to public transit, Waymo’s all-weather Driver can provide an additional option that complements the city’s transportation ecosystem. The data from over 400 million fully autonomous kilometres driven shows the Waymo Driver was involved in 95% fewer (20x fewer) crashes involving serious injury or worse compared to humans in the cities where we operate.Safety and accessibility are fundamental to Waymo's mission to be the world's most trusted driver, and we're proud to collaborate with leading accessibility and mobility advocacy organizations, including BALANCE for Blind Adults, CNIB, Community Living Toronto, Connected Canadians, and Epilepsy Ontario, among others.“Innovation that removes barriers to independence is at the heart of everything we do. Waymo’s history of partnering with the sight loss community to build accessible solutions is encouraging and their decision to engage with us early reflects the kind of approach that leads to real results,” said Michelle McQuigge, CEO, BALANCE for Blind Adults.We can't wait to help residents and visitors explore everything Toronto has to offer. If you’re ready to experience Waymo in Toronto, please sign up for updates to be among the first to ride when we’re ready: waymo.com/waymo-in-canada.Waymo arrive officiellement au Canada ! Nous préparons le lancement de notre service de transport par véhicules autonomes à Toronto. Nous investissons dans les infrastructures locales et dans la création d’emplois en vue d’accueillir nos premiers passagers en 2028.Au cours des prochains jours, vous commencerez à voir des véhicules Waymo circuler dans les rues de Toronto, avec un conducteur au volant. Notre démarche est rigoureuse et axée avant tout sur la sécurité. Nous procédons par étapes, en commençant par cartographier le réseau routier local en haute définition, puis en effectuant des essais avec des spécialistes qualifiés de la conduite autonome au volant. Cette phase nous permettra de vérifier que le Waymo Driver s’adapte aux conditions de conduite propres à Toronto.« Notre arrivée au Canada marque une étape importante dans le développement international de Waymo », a déclaré Tekedra Mawakana, codirectrice générale de l’entreprise. « Toronto est l’une des plus grandes métropoles du monde : une ville innovante, diversifiée et résolument tournée vers l’avenir. Nous sommes fiers d’introduire le Waymo Driver dans la plus grande ville du Canada et de collaborer avec les communautés dynamiques des affaires, des arts et de la culture qui partagent notre engagement envers des rues plus sécuritaires et une mobilité plus accessible. »Pour assurer notre service à Toronto, nous faisons équipe avec Element Fleet Management, une entreprise dont le siège social se trouve à Toronto et qui est un leader mondial des solutions intelligentes de gestion de flottes et de mobilité. Element nous fournira des services complets de gestion de flottes. Avec Element et nos autres partenaires, nous investirons progressivement dans la création de centaines d’emplois liés à l’entretien de la flotte, aux essais sur route, au service à la clientèle et à d’autres activités nécessaires à l’exploitation de notre service. Ce partenariat s’inscrit dans la continuité des liens que Waymo a déjà tissés avec le Canada, notamment avec l’Office d’investissement du régime de pensions du Canada (Investissements RPC), un investisseur de longue date, et Magna International, son partenaire manufacturier.« En tant qu’entreprise canadienne, nous sommes fiers d’élargir notre partenariat avec Waymo afin de contribuer à l’arrivée des services de transport de personnes à la demande par véhicules autonomes à Toronto, a déclaré Laura Dottori-Attanasio, présidente et cheffe de la direction d’Element Fleet Management. Ensemble, Element et Waymo contribueront à créer des possibilités d’emploi en mettant à profit l’expertise d’Element en gestion de flottes, ses capacités opérationnelles et ses solutions de mobilité intelligente pour soutenir le déploiement à grande échelle de flottes de véhicules autonomes, tout en assurant la fiabilité de leurs opérations. »Toronto figure parmi les régions métropolitaines dont la croissance est la plus rapide en Amérique du Nord. Les besoins en matière de mobilité y évoluent et les options de transport se multiplient. Des pistes cyclables au transport en commun, le Waymo Driver, conçu pour fonctionner par tous les temps, pourrait offrir une option supplémentaire en complément des moyens de transport existants. Selon les données recueillies sur plus de 400 millions de kilomètres parcourus en conduite entièrement autonome, les véhicules Waymo ont été impliqués dans 95 % moins d’accidents entraînant des blessures graves ou plus graves que les véhicules conduits par des humains dans les villes où le service est offert. Cela représente 20 fois moins d’accidents de ce type.La sécurité et l’accessibilité sont à la base de la mission de Waymo : devenir le service de conduite autonome auquel le public fait le plus confiance au monde. Nous sommes fiers de collaborer avec des organismes de premier plan qui œuvrent en faveur de l’accessibilité et de la mobilité, notamment BALANCE for Blind Adults, l’Institut national canadien pour les aveugles (INCA), Community Living Toronto, Connected Canadians et Epilepsy Ontario.« L’innovation qui favorise l’autonomie est au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. L’expérience de Waymo en matière de collaboration avec des personnes ayant une déficience visuelle pour concevoir des solutions accessibles est encourageante. Sa décision de nous consulter dès le début montre qu’une telle approche peut donner des résultats concrets », a déclaré Michelle McQuigge, PDG de BALANCE for Blind Adults.Nous sommes ravis d’aider les résidents et les visiteurs à découvrir tout ce que Toronto a à offrir. Si vous avez envie de faire l’essai du Waymo Driver à Toronto, inscrivez-vous pour recevoir nos mises à jour et être parmi les premiers informés du lancement de notre service : waymo.com/waymo-in-canada.

comments.author: SenHeng
comments.textRawHtml:
I happened to drive past 2 of them in Tokyo a couple of weeks ago. One was making a left turn into an alley, another was on the otherwise of the road so I never got to see how they actually drove but I giddily squealed like a happy pig rolling in the mud WAYMO! as I tried explaining to my shocked wife wtf was going on. It's been so long since I've had this feel of wonder when seeing technology.

I'm so going to ride in one once they're open to the public.
comments.textZhHtml:
几周前我在东京碰巧开车经过其中两个。其中一个左转进入一条小巷，另一个在道路的另一边，所以我从来没有看到他们实际上是如何驾驶的，但我像一头快乐的猪在泥里打滚一样令人眼花缭乱地尖叫着！当我试图向我震惊的妻子解释到底发生了什么时。我已经很久没有在看到技术时有过这种惊奇的感觉了。

一旦它们向公众开放，我就很想乘坐其中。

children.author: weitendorf
children.textRawHtml:
I’m so glad to see someone excited about them, because this is how I felt when they first started to go live in San Francisco. Now I take them multiple times a week, and have been doing so for multiple years.

They really do feel like magic, and give you palpable proof that you’re living in the future.
children.textZhHtml:
我很高兴看到有人对他们感到兴奋，因为这就是他们第一次在旧金山上线时我的感受。现在，我每周服用多次，并且已经这样做了很多年。

它们确实感觉像魔法，并给你明显的证据，证明你生活在未来。

children.author: skyberrys
children.textRawHtml: I live under the flight path for an airport, which should be kind of annoying. Instead I find it inspiring to hear the roar of the jets and see the small planes hurling through the air. We dreamed of the day for so long and now it is common!
children.textZhHtml: 我住在机场的飞行路线下，这应该有点烦人。相反，听到喷气式飞机的轰鸣声和看到小型飞机在空中呼啸而过，我觉得很鼓舞人心。我们梦想这一天很久了，现在它已经很常见了！

children.author: lanyard-textile
children.textZhHtml:
相同。 :)

工业界的“单调”声音。

children.author: dekhn
children.textRawHtml: I started working at Google in 2008 and while walking to lunch one day saw some of the early self-driving cars in a parking lot, just sitting there idle.  They had a funny mast that didn't look like street view and I distinctly remember thinking "wait, Google is working on self driving cars"?
children.textZhHtml: 我于 2008 年开始在 Google 工作，有一天，当我步行去吃午饭时，看到停车场里有一些早期的自动驾驶汽车闲置在那里。  他们有一个有趣的桅杆，看起来不像街景，我清楚地记得我在想“等等，谷歌正在开发自动驾驶汽车”？

children.author: jnsie
children.textRawHtml: Took a few last year on a trip to San Francisco and it felt like the future. It's not lost on me that enshittification will take its toll,  the fleet will get nastier over time, prices will increase, etc. I'm also torn about more money being given to mega corporations. But purely from a service-enjoyment and technology-appreciation point of view it was amazing!
children.textZhHtml: 去年去旧金山旅行时拍了一些照片，感觉就像是未来。我并没有忘记，混乱化将会造成损失，随着时间的推移，船队会变得更糟糕，价格会上涨，等等。我也对向大公司提供更多资金感到不安。但纯粹从服务享受和技术欣赏的角度来看，这真是太棒了！

children.author: ricardobayes
children.textRawHtml:
Is it that you feel it's amazing, because San Francisco never had the European-style, cheap and elegant taxi that gets you chaffeured around in a Mercedes E-class by a shirt-wearing, well-dressed person who helps you with your luggage? You can call them with an app.

For me, Waymos are a downgrade in the same way Uber was, too. I'm not even going to expand the conversation to German/Swiss/Dutch-style clean, fast and cheap public transportation. Waymo is basically good public transportation to places which don't have public transportation and don't want it. I have no doubt this comment won't really land with those who have not experienced the European-style taxis or public transportation.
children.textZhHtml:
你是否觉得这很神奇，因为旧金山从来没有那种欧式、廉价、优雅的出租车，让你开着奔驰 E 级车，有一个穿着衬衫、衣着考究的人帮你拿行李？你可以用应用程序给他们打电话。

对我来说，Waymos 是一种降级，就像 Uber 一样。我什至不打算将话题扩展到德国/瑞士/荷兰式的清洁、快速和廉价的公共交通。 Waymo 基本上是前往没有公共交通且不想要公共交通的地方的良好公共交通。我毫不怀疑，对于那些没有体验过欧式出租车或公共交通的人来说，这个评论不会真正落地。

children.author: rcxdude
children.textRawHtml: I think the lack of any person involved is part of the appeal for a lot of people. The lower cost does also help, I think it will be interesting to see if the notional price advantage from the lack of driver will bear out over time, though.
children.textZhHtml: 我认为缺乏任何人参与是对很多人的吸引力的一部分。较低的成本也确实有所帮助，不过，我认为看看由于缺乏司机而带来的名义价格优势是否会随着时间的推移而得到证实，这将会很有趣。

children.author: sneak
children.textRawHtml:
Enshittification is only when there is a captive/sticky audience that has high switching costs. “Drive you from A to B” has no moat and they will continue to have to compete on merit and price. Here in Vegas there are 3, soon to be 4+, driverless taxi services currently operating.

Also, you can’t praise an amazing service that takes insane amounts of r&d money to bring to market in the same breath as complaining about giving money to massive corporations. No two guys in a garage are starting a self-driving car company or a supersonic jet company by themselves. Massive capital is required to launch satellites, build cars, build datacenters, etc.
children.textZhHtml:
只有当存在具有较高转换成本的俘虏/粘性受众时，才会出现Enshitification。 “载你从 A 到 B”没有护城河，他们将继续在品质和价格上竞争。 在维加斯，目前有 3 家（很快将有 4 家以上）无人驾驶出租车服务正在运营。

此外，你不能一边抱怨向大公司提供资金，一边赞扬一项需要大量研发资金才能推向市场的出色服务。 车库里没有两个人能够独自创办一家自动驾驶汽车公司或一家超音速喷气式飞机公司。 发射卫星、制造汽车、建设数据中心等都需要大量资金。

children.author: majormajor
children.textRawHtml:
>Enshittification is only when there is a captive/sticky audience that has high switching costs. “Drive you from A to B” has no moat and they will continue to have to compete on merit and price.

No, in this case enshittification will be driven by the cost of entry for a new player. That'll create enough of a capital cost hurdle to prevent a duopoly or triopoly-type situation from entering a natural state of complacency and degradation.

How many tens of millions would you be willing to spend to launch your own fleet of self-driving cars in a city (just one for that price! and that's with no R&D!) just because the Waymos are dirty, smelly, and noisy?
children.textZhHtml:
>仅当存在具有高转换成本的俘虏/粘性受众时，才会出现Enshitification。 “载你从 A 到 B”没有护城河，他们将继续在品质和价格上竞争。

不，在这种情况下，enshitification 将由新玩家的进入成本驱动。这将创造足够的资本成本障碍，以防止双头垄断或三头垄断式的局面进入自满和退化的自然状态。

仅仅因为 Waymo 脏、臭、吵，你愿意花几千万在一个城市推出自己的自动驾驶车队（这个价格就只有一辆！而且没有研发！）？

children.author: vlovich123
children.textRawHtml: Not true. Enshittification also happens when they cut the quality of the service to improve their margins which they need to do for whatever reason (competition on price, profit improvements etc). Thats why the cheapest tier the quality of the vehicles will be worse and all services will run like that because that’s all you can achieve at that price point (unless they figure out how to have automated distributed cleaning stations and even then that’s tricky because the car is still out of commission and losing you money to get cleaned even if it’s only a minor detour).
children.textZhHtml: 不正确。当他们出于任何原因（价格竞争、利润提高等）而降低服务质量以提高利润时，也会发生Enshittification。这就是为什么最便宜的级别车辆的质量会更差，所有服务都会像这样运行，因为这就是你在这个价位上所能实现的一切（除非他们弄清楚如何拥有自动化的分布式清洁站，即使这样，这也很棘手，因为汽车仍然无法使用，并且即使只是绕了一小段路，你也会因为清洁而损失金钱）。

children.author: refurb
children.textRawHtml:
Enshitification is just price conscious consumers willingly trading quality for price.

If it actually hurt companies they would stop doing it
children.textZhHtml:
Enshitification只是对价格敏感的消费者愿意以质量换取价格。

如果它真的伤害了公司，他们就会停止这样做

children.author: vlovich123
children.textRawHtml:
Not necessarily. It also means segmenting the market to extreme lengths so that even a marginal increase in quality is combined with a significantly greater price. It’s about pushing the most price sensitive customers to have the worst quality while the less price insensitive you get a marginally better product for an outsized increase in cost.

I remain convinced that while value extraction is higher in this model, the world people generally want to live in is one where the ability of businesses to price discriminate in this way is not so unbridled.
children.textZhHtml:
不一定。它还意味着将市场细分到极致，这样即使质量的微小提高也会带来显着更高的价格。这是为了让对价格最敏感的客户获得最差的质量，而对价格不敏感的客户则可以通过大幅增加成本获得稍微更好的产品。

我仍然相信，虽然在这种模式中价值提取更高，但人们普遍希望生活的世界是企业以这种方式进行价格歧视的能力不会那么肆无忌惮的世界。

children.author: rcxdude
children.textRawHtml: Enshittification is generally an exploitation of market efficiencies in some form, be it lock-in effects or market dominance in an area with a high barrier to entry. It's an explicit goal of a lot of investment: pick one company in an area, invest so much money into it no-one else can compete, corner the market by offering a better product than anyone else, then once you own the market, turn up the price and turn down the quality to get as much money out of it before someone builds a competitor and your customers can leave.
children.textZhHtml: Enshittification 通常是以某种形式利用市场效率，无论是锁定效应还是在进入壁垒较高的领域的市场主导地位。这是大量投资的明确目标：在一个领域选择一家公司，向其中投入大量资金，让其他人无法竞争，通过提供比其他任何人更好的产品来垄断市场，然后一旦你拥有了市场，就提高价格并降低质量，以便在有人建立竞争对手并且你的客户离开之前从中获取尽可能多的钱。

children.author: stasomatic
children.textRawHtml: I am not. They can alpha test elsewhere.
children.textZhHtml: 我不是。他们可以在其他地方进行 alpha 测试。

children.author: solyin
children.textRawHtml: What metrics would you accept for you not to consider it an alpha test? Because they've been running in Phoenix, Az since April, 2017, and have been offering rides to the general public in San Francisco since June 2024. It doesn't handle Boston winters, it doesn't handle torrential rain, but it's a bit past "alpha" stage.
children.textZhHtml: 您会接受哪些指标来避免将其视为 alpha 测试？因为他们自 2017 年 4 月以来一直在亚利桑那州凤凰城运营，并自 2024 年 6 月起一直在旧金山向公众提供乘车服务。它无法应对波士顿的冬天，也无法应对暴雨，但它已经过了“阿尔法”阶段。

children.author: stasomatic
children.textRawHtml: Alpha <- I should've put that in quotes, I suppose. My tolerance level is lower than yours, that's cool, but I am not getting into these things nor any robot drone choppers or planes. I can barely trust my HDA2 (ADAS) in my Ioniq 5 to not steer me into a rail guard.
children.textZhHtml: Alpha <- 我想我应该把它放在引号中。我的容忍度比你低，这很酷，但我不会涉及这些事情，也不会涉及任何机器人无人机直升机或飞机。我几乎无法相信 Ioniq 5 中的 HDA2 (ADAS) 不会引导我撞上护栏。

children.author: onlypassingthru
children.textRawHtml: Judging all self-driving tech by one brand is as ridiculous as judging all hamburgers by one from McDonalds. Hyundai's capability is years behind Tesla and Waymo because they started actual years later than the best.
children.textZhHtml: 用一个品牌来评判所有自动驾驶技术就像用麦当劳的一个品牌来评判所有汉堡包一样荒谬。现代汽车的能力落后特斯拉和 Waymo 几年，因为它们实际上比最好的公司晚了几年。

children.author: stasomatic
children.textRawHtml:
Hey, I liked FSD quite a bit, but it was just 3 times. I am eyeing a Juniper Tesla Y after my Ioniq lease runs out and I'll happily pay the $100/m extra for FSD, but I am the fallback.

Waymo, I don't care how advanced it is, I am not getting into a 2K kg robot on public roads. Ironically, they are switching their fleet to the Ioniq 5 but what's under the hood must be completely different.

Burgers, not my thing, can't relate.

汉堡，不是我的菜，无法联系起来。
